tasks.name: Clickstream Sessionization with Inactivity Gaps
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH event_intervals AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id
                ORDER BY event_timestamp, event_id
            ) > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE THEN 1
            WHEN LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id
                ORDER BY event_timestamp, event_id
            ) IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_new_session
    FROM user_events
),
session_tags AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id
            ORDER BY event_timestamp
        ) AS session_id
    FROM event_intervals
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM session_tags
GROUP BY
    user_id,
    session_id
ORDER BY
    user_id ASC,
    session_start ASC;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH lagged AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE 
                 OR LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_new_session
    FROM user_events
),
session_indexed AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CAST(SUM(is_new_session) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS BIGINT) AS session_id
    FROM lagged
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM session_indexed
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_start ASC;

tasks.name: Sequential Multi-Stage User Onboarding Conversion Funnel
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH user_funnel AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'view_item' THEN event_time END) AS first_view_time
    FROM user_journey_events
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'view_item' THEN event_time END) IS NOT NULL
),
cart_events AS (
    SELECT
        f.user_id,
        MIN(e.event_time) AS first_cart_time
    FROM user_funnel f
    JOIN user_journey_events e
      ON f.user_id = e.user_id
     AND e.event_name = 'add_to_cart'
     AND e.event_time > f.first_view_time
    GROUP BY f.user_id
),
purchase_events AS (
    SELECT
        c.user_id,
        MIN(e.event_time) AS first_purchase_time
    FROM cart_events c
    JOIN user_journey_events e
      ON c.user_id = e.user_id
     AND e.event_name = 'purchase'
     AND e.event_time > c.first_cart_time
    GROUP BY c.user_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS total_viewers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS converted_cart,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) AS converted_purchase
FROM user_funnel f
LEFT JOIN cart_events c
  ON f.user_id = c.user_id
LEFT JOIN purchase_events p
  ON c.user_id = p.user_id;
